beforeAfterControl.before: A synthetic conventional UUID-only foreign key accepted one child whose tenant differed from its referenced project. This is a control model, not old deployed application behavior.
beforeAfterControl.after: The scoped migration rejected the same tenant/project IDs with SQLSTATE 23503, even under the migration owner. Real restricted-login tests also verified tenant/project row policies.

manualReviewRegression.case: Permissive ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES granting all tables to PUBLIC
manualReviewRegression.before: One focused test failed: application access to global accounts incorrectly succeeded in the initial local draft.
manualReviewRegression.resolution: Explicitly revoke PUBLIC/application default table access before least-privilege grants. Refuse pre-existing application roles with unknown rights rather than reusing them.
manualReviewRegression.after: All 19 checks pass with permissive owner defaults, a real restricted runtime login, owner-role escalation denial and row_security=off denial.
